_about: A. E. Taylor (1869-1945), idealist and Platonist. Raw IA OCR: The Problem of Conduct, a study in the phenomenology of ethics (London: Macmillan, 1901), clean 0.95; Elements of Metaphysics (London: Methuen; first published 1903, this copy the fourth edition, 1915), clean 0.91; Thomas Hobbes, in Philosophies Ancient and Modern (London: Constable, 1908), clean 0.93; Aristotle, revised edition, The People's Books (London: Jack; Nelson, 1919), clean 0.92. His translation of Metaphysics A (1907) stands on the aristotle shelf. Held: his Plato in the same Constable series (plato00taylrich), whose copy shows no printed year. US public domain. No uids minted. Added 2026-10-23: clean Gutenberg witnesses (slugs ending -pg) beside the raw OCR of the same works. Round dw (2026-10-23) added, raw IA OCR with title pages read: Plato (Constable, 1908); Epicurus (preface St Andrews, July 1910); Varia Socratica, first series (Oxford, 1911); Platonism and its Influence (Boston: Marshall Jones, 1924); Plato, the Man and his Work, third edition revised and enlarged (Methuen, 1929). His Aristotle on his Predecessors is on the aristotle shelf.
